description: This Scala source file defines utility functions for converting Spark SQL Rows into Thrift-compatible row sets, supporting both row-based and column-based formats, with handling for various data types and null values.
external_files: org.apache.spark.sql.types.{BinaryType, BooleanType, ByteType, DataType, DoubleType, FloatType, IntegerType, LongType, ShortType, StringType}

methods.name: bitSetToBuffer
methods.description: Converts a Java BitSet to a ByteBuffer.

methods.name: toTRowSet
methods.description: Converts a sequence of Spark Rows into a Thrift TRowSet, choosing row-based or column-based format based on protocol version.

methods.name: toRowBasedSet
methods.description: Creates a Thrift row set in row-based format from Spark Rows.

methods.name: toColumnBasedSet
methods.description: Creates a Thrift row set in column-based format from Spark Rows.

methods.name: toTColumn
methods.description: Converts a specific column across multiple Rows into a Thrift TColumn, handling various data types.

methods.name: getOrSetAsNull
methods.description: Retrieves column values from Rows, setting nulls and default values where appropriate.

methods.name: toTColumnValue
methods.description: Converts a single cell value from a Row into a Thrift TColumnValue, based on data type.
